content.short: ChainShot offers a 100% live online bootcamp to acquire skills in blockchain and smart contracts.
content.description: ChainShot's bootcamp delivers a practical path for developers to acquire technical Web3 know-how through a project-driven curriculum. The course emphasizes hands-on work, with participants building a full Proof-of-Work blockchain, deploying numerous smart contracts, and creating several decentralized applications. In addition, the program provides a personal IDE and a collaborative classroom tool designed to support learning, code sharing, and teamwork throughout the training.
